name: lfx-marketing-os
description: Public plugin marketplace for The Linux Foundation's LFX Marketing OS agents and skills.

plugins.name: brand-guidelines-agent
plugins.description: Interviews an LF project leader and generates a Brand Kit: positioning, voice, messaging, and visual identity direction.

plugins.name: message-foundation-agent
plugins.description: Interviews a project lead and produces a Message Foundation doc for web, content, social, and campaigns.

plugins.name: icp-target-markets-agent
plugins.description: Builds a Target Markets & ICP document with personas and fit/warmth scoring from the foundation docs.

plugins.name: plain-writing
plugins.description: Writes and revises prose in a plain style: simple words, complete sentences, no jargon or filler.

plugins.name: website-designer-agent
plugins.description: Turns the foundation docs into an approved sitemap, complete Hugo site, and DNS-ready launch package.

plugins.name: qtrly-plan-agent
plugins.description: Guides the quarterly review cycle and produces a Google Slides-ready quarterly marketing plan deck.

plugins.name: lf-zoom-hubspot-notes-logger
plugins.description: Syncs Zoom meeting notes into HubSpot meeting records, opens follow-up tasks, and flags ambiguous matches for review.

plugins.name: member-360
plugins.description: Scores each member's engagement across LF activities and recommends next best actions in a QBR-ready spreadsheet.

plugins.name: committee-health-agent
plugins.description: Monitors committee participation, flags inactive or missing member representatives, and drafts outreach for review.

plugins.name: linkedin-post-agent
plugins.description: Drafts LinkedIn posts about LF and open source work in the user's authentic voice, from any source content.

plugins.name: pitch-deck-agent
plugins.description: Generates the standard first-meeting membership pitch deck, grounded in the project's foundation docs.

plugins.name: case-study-agent
plugins.description: Converts any source content into an on-brand case study, blog post, article, summary, or Q&A Word doc.

plugins.name: ambassador-content-assignment
plugins.description: Matches ambassadors to LF event schedules, generates personalized content assignments, and tracks who posts.

plugins.name: aeo-geo-analyzer
plugins.description: Scores a website's AEO/GEO performance and returns prioritized recommendations.

plugins.name: social-listening-report
plugins.description: Builds Voices That Matter, Campaign Echo, and Ask-Anything reports from LFX Lens social listening data.

plugins.name: community-monitor-agent
plugins.description: Watches Slack channels and GitHub repos, ranks community questions, and delivers a live report with drafted replies.

plugins.name: marketing-agent-class
plugins.description: Delivers the LF Claude Agent Workshop training as personalized slide decks with live student Q&A capture.
